Subject: POC: Trial environment options (hosted vs dedicated sandbox vs VPC) - recap and next steps

Hi Sofia / Tom —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

1) Success criteria (as discussed):
   - 95th percentile latency under 300ms for inference (50 token prompt + 128 token generation)
   - Cost per 1k tokens under $X (we'll propose optimization knobs)
   - No data exfiltration in evaluation (logs retained in your account for 90 days)
   - Accuracy/behavior benchmarks on your 40-case prompt set (pass rate >= 90%)

2) Trial environments to evaluate (we recommended all three in parallel where feasible):
   - Hosted (Redwood API) — fastest to stand up; we provide a sandbox key and sample workloads. Good to validate latency/cost on our curated instance.
   - Dedicated sandbox — reserved GPU pool in our infra for your test workloads; better isolation and more representative throughput for bursty queries.
   - VPC trial (hosted VPC) — customer-managed network with private connectivity; required for procurement/security signoff if you need private networking.

3) Proposed evaluation plan & timelines:
   - Week 0 (this week): sign MOU for trial scope + share evaluation datasets & prompt sets.
   - Week 1: hosted sandbox spin-up + baseline runs; SRE will provide sample scripts.
   - Week 2: dedicated sandbox spin-up (if agreed) and perf runs; compare latency/throughput.
   - Week 3: VPC onboarding (if needed) — expect extra network steps (VPN, firewall rules).
   - Week 4: results review; decision discussion for next steps (pilot/POC expansion).

4) Owners:
   - Redwood: Marissa (commercial lead), Neha (solutions engineer), Dev (infra onboarding)
   - Acme AI: Sofia (technical lead), Tom (product), Procurement contact (procurement@acmeai.com)

5) Action items from us (I will):
   - Send POC plan + hosted vs VPC comparison (attached).
   - Share HubSpot deal and DS links for signatures.
   - Loop in infra (Dev) to schedule the VPC pre-check if you want that path.

If this looks right, please: (a) confirm the success criteria above or list modifications, (b) indicate which environment(s) you want to run first, and (c) confirm the person doing procurement (cc'd) so I can share the MOU.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you the sandbox access.

Best,
Marissa Cole
